goal: A portfolio site with landing, projects and contact pages on one shared theme, checked by a reviewer and merged once every screenshot matches the outline

steps.title: Outline pages, sections and theme values
steps.proof: docs/OUTLINE.md names each page, its sections, colours and fonts

steps.title: Write the shared theme stylesheet
steps.proof: site/styles.css contains every colour and font from docs/OUTLINE.md

steps.title: Build the landing page
steps.proof: Screenshot of the landing page at 1280x800 shows hero and footer

steps.title: Build the projects gallery
steps.proof: Screenshot shows all project cards from the outline

steps.title: Build the contact page and form
steps.proof: Screenshot shows the form; each input has a label

steps.title: Check pages against the outline
steps.proof: QA report lists issues by file and line, or none

steps.title: Apply review fixes
steps.proof: Every QA issue is marked fixed in the report; screenshots retaken

steps.title: Merge the site branch
steps.proof: `git merge site` succeeds and all three pages open locally
